sentence: This project builds deep-learning models that use electronic health records to predict how vancomycin should be given to each patient.
This project screens natural compounds to find safe and effective agents that lower the risk of breast cancer.
This project builds a way to deliver small RNA drugs straight into triple negative breast cancer cells using exosomes and tests it in murine models.
This project builds virtual rats with artificial brains that behave and learn like real rats, then studies how those brains control behavior.
This project develops an imaging method that uses a shortened scan from routine clinical scans to give extra information for clinical decisions.
This project develops antimicrobial peptides designed with AI to fight multidrug-resistant infections.
This project studies how mutations in two genes change gene expression in human immune cells, using engineered cells and mathematical models.
This project studies how circadian regulation affects ion channels in cardiomyocytes and whether feeding behavior can change the risk of cardiac arrhythmias.
This project studies why acute myeloid leukemia cells become resistant to drugs and looks for drug combinations that work better.
This project studies how contact sites between lysosomes and the Golgi sustain inflammation linked to senescence.
This project studies how parts of the entopeduncular nucleus in mice help them choose between seeking reward and avoiding threat.
This project tests a computerized treatment aimed at interpretation bias to improve response to exposure and response prevention treatment.
This project builds a machine-learning tool that reads electronic health records to identify and classify cases of status epilepticus.
This project studies how a gene fusion drives salivary gland cancer, using xenograft and genetically engineered mouse models.
This project studies how enteroendocrine cells in the gut and the vagus nerve affect nicotine addiction.
This project builds imaging and microscopy methods to study how neutrophils act in inflammation and coronary artery disease.
This project combines neuroimaging data from many groups of patients to detect Alzheimer's disease and related dementias earlier.
This project tries to find small molecules that break down a protein and can enter the brain, as drugs for glioblastoma.
This project studies how macrophage metabolism changes during endotoxin tolerance and how that shapes the inflammatory response.
